## Filing addendum · #29607 · 2026-11-02T22:26Z

Carried from the hardening note in ① of the contract review on PR #29621 (#29434, head `f3ff3349`), as item 2 of this card. This is source reading, non-blocking.

The #29341 advisory (`connector-credential-literal`) does not judge the `transport.credentialEnv` string itself. Suppose a secret is typed into it by mistake, in a form that passes the env-var-name check (underscore and alphanumerics). It would then be served on a metadata read and echoed by two configuration refusals.

**Wanted:** the advisory runs its credential-literal predicate on `credentialEnv` too, and warns when the value looks like a secret rather than a name. That is a warning only, so no accept set moves.
